response.sql: WITH station_counts AS (SELECT o.observstation, COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count FROM observatories AS o LEFT JOIN telescopes AS t ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation), shares AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, telescope_count * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(telescope_count) OVER (), 0) AS share FROM station_counts), compared AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, share - average_share AS share_above_average FROM compared WHERE share > average_share ORDER BY share_above_average DESC LIMIT 10;
